BiblicalUsage: Pethay is width, breadth, and it is measured on two great buildings. Nebuchadnezzar's golden image stands sixty cubits high and six cubits broad, and Cyrus decrees the rebuilt temple in Jerusalem to be sixty cubits high and sixty cubits broad.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the two widths judge each other: the king's image is tall and narrow, made to be worshipped, while God's house is square and broad, made for His people to meet Him.
